subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is related to Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyaan (GKRA)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**It was started in 116 districts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** is set to introduce the** 'Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan' (GKRA)** on **June 20, 2020**, in response to the **employment crisis** that migrant laborers are facing as a result of the **COVID-19 pandemic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The Prime Minister will introduce this campaign via **video conference** from the **Bihar** village of **Telihar** in the **Khagaria district**.
 
• The government plans to invest roughly **Rs 50 thousand crores** under the **"Garib Kalyan Rozgar Abhiyan."**
 
• This campaign, which runs in mission mode, will last for** 125 days**.
 
• This program involves the **six states** of **Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Jharkhand, and Odisha**.
 
• Over** 25,000 migrant workers** from six districts, spread over **116 districts**—including 27 aspirational districts—have been chosen to participate in the program.
 
• Through **Common Service Centers **and** "Krishi Vigyan Kendras,"** which will also be implemented taking in mind the physical separation norms enforced owing to Corona, villages in **116 districts of the six states **participating in this program will be included.
 
• **The Panchayati Raj, Rural Development, Road Transport and Highways, Mines, Drinking Water and Sanitation, Environment, Railways, Renewable Energy, Petroleum and Natural Gas, Border Roads, Telecom, and Agriculture ministries** are among the **twelve departments** that will oversee the campaign.
